observations.distinct_identities: All 14 existing and 14 concept identities have distinguishable faces, hair, wardrobes, silhouettes and poses. Their styles remain clear at native LCD resolution.
observations.full_bodies: Nia and the 14 concept bodies retain complete heads, hands and feet. Shoes and feet contact the floor above the browser UI.
observations.upper_body: The 13 restyled story actors use close portraits ending at the lower illustration edge, without floating torsos above the floor.
observations.ui: Name, count, style, two-row description and outfit label fit the reserved lower 96 rows, without character overlap.
observations.seam: Backgrounds and actors continue across logical rows 191/192, without duplicated or blank bands.

character-replacement-results.json.intentional_reexport: Intentional native 256x264 speaking-frame reexport of original source art, plus five additional approved Nia full bodies; historical 168px packed payload hashes are retained only as provenance.
character-replacement-results.json.intentional_wardrobe_replacement: The character wardrobe overhaul replaces 13 existing non-Nia actors and adds 14 unassigned gallery concepts. Story text, actor IDs, Nia art and all background payloads remain unchanged.
